note: Set A binds the key fabrication facts correctly — SIP thickness with vapor barrier, 3" steel decking, 3/4" exterior-grade plywood, PL 8 x 3/8 with 7/16" holes at 12" O.C., lag screw with washer, and the sealant/waterproofing notes — with mostly supporting quotes. Set B introduces several misbindings and inventions: it merges the W10 x 15 beam into a 'steel decking' spec, calls 3/4" a deck thickness (it is the plywood), invents 'connection to joist', 'connection | frame' and 'center to center' conditions, and mangles the nail entity ('ank nail') with a truncated quote. Set A is not clean either: both 8'-0" claims are misbound to the A3 module-to-module connection when the dimension belongs to the A1 typical deck module, the nail value is misread as '8 8D', and the through-bolt quote is a fragment ('OUGH BOLT'), plus it carries duplicates and self-referential claims. Overall A is more faithful and has fewer substantive errors, though both sets pad with repeated/trivial entries.
